mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM products p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.seller_id WHERE p.product_id=#{id} AND (p.seller_id=#{uid} OR p.audit_status='通过')

SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS seller_nickname, f.favorited_at FROM favorites f JOIN products p ON p.product_id=f.product_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.seller_id WHERE f.user_id=#{uid} AND (p.seller_id=#{uid} OR p.audit_status='通过') ORDER BY f.favorited_at DESC, p.product_id DESC

SELECT o.order_id,o.product_id,o.buyer_id,o.snapshot_title,o.deal_price_cents, o.shipping_fee_cents,o.order_status,o.created_at,p.seller_id,u.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id=o.product_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.seller_id WHERE o.buyer_id=#{uid} ORDER BY o.order_id DESC
